Sol dispatch died on ChatGPT usage limit (resets 2026-10-12 00:59) before recording findings. Re-run by adversarial Opus 5.5 Agent with the identical brief (.worktrees/.dispatch/eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.3.prompt).
FRESH FULL REVIEW (Opus 5.5 standing in for Sol) at exact head 767ab4f66ceb8c579fe8897221003ca38b63639f, worktree .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.3, read-only (no edits/format/commit/push). Profile rules-clause-complete + semantic-system. METHOD: read-only Python dump of EVERY non-effect magic-item block (184 items: 361 operations incl. variants, 49 state machines, all economies, entityGrants, containment, spellStore, rollManipulation, randomProcedure, curse, 107 adjudicated clauses) beside each full printed description in records.json; every row read. Also read magicItemFaithfulOperations.ts, ...OperationsCorpus.ts, ...Lifecycles.ts, ...SpecKit.ts, registry diff, magicItemMechanics.ts schema diff, the whole new magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts, consumers itemState/itemExecutionReadiness/magicItemVariants/itemResetExecutor. VERIFIED: importer regenerated into scratch -> records.json byte-IDENTICAL (no drift); targeted tests pass (magicItemOperationSourceAgreement 63/63; srdGeneratedPack, magicItemLegacyCapabilityBacklog, magicItemMechanicsSchema, alternativeOptionProjections, magicItemEffectSourceAgreement 394/394). RUNTIME SAFETY: no runtime consumer reads activation/termination/revertOn/control/exclusiveInstance (magicItemVariants only merges activation objects); readiness pins the 19-op green set (test passes); every verbatim-span/clause check is enforced at compile and in kindSchemas; S2.01-S2.45, S3.01-S3.10, S4.02-S4.08/S4.10-S4.12, S5.01-S5.06, S6.01-S6.06, S1.16-S1.18 members verified as stated EXCEPT where noted below. Edited test expectations (clause counts, backlog hash, Orb requirement) are source-backed. Four blocking root-cause groups follow.
S1 - Typed operation activations still omit printed eligibility, actor and target predicates (S2 class not closed corpus-wide). Invariant/authority: bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent (a typed claim states the printed predicate exactly; never broader); owning bead 19.4.6 (whole corpus, 'Anything use_item can execute must be exactly faithful'); 19.4.5.7 S2 incl. S2.23 ('Rod is not declared a weapon; general weapon wielding does not supply this explicit prerequisite'). Child 2's notes claim operation-level hand reading of all non-table items; the members below survive it. Members (all in records.json; producers named): (a) STAFF casts omit printed 'While holding': Staff of Charming cast-charm-person/cast-command/cast-comprehend-languages; Staff of Fire 3 casts; Staff of Frost 4; Staff of Healing 3; Staff of Power 9 spell casts; Staff of Swarming Insects cast-giant-insect, cast-insect-plague, create-insect-cloud ('Insect Cloud. While holding the staff'); Staff of the Magi 13 charged casts (+6 'You can also use an action' free casts in the same holding paragraph) - producers magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:785-925 / magicItemChargeEconomies.ts:516-660. The PR's own corpus table types holding for every wand, rod, Mace of Terror, Wind Fan and Trident (magicItemFaithfulOperationsCorpus.ts:937-954); Staff of the Woodlands and Staff of Thunder and Lightning print no holding and are correctly untyped (negative siblings). Scenario: cast fireball from a stowed Staff of Fire. (b) Ring of Elemental Command: all 13 post-slay casts (cast-chain-lightning ... cast-wall-of-ice) type only 'If you help slay a(n) X elemental while attuned to the ring' and drop the printed variant gate that the dominate ops type ('Ring of Air Elemental Command') and the bound c2-cast-* effects carry ('only a Ring of Air Elemental Command, after you help slay...'). Scenario: wearer of a FIRE-linked ring who helped slay an air elemental satisfies the typed requirement of cast-chain-lightning. The test title 'plane-gated casts' (magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts ~line 506) overstates this. (c) Folding Boat fold-boat lacks 'provided that no creatures are aboard' (sibling Instant Fortress dismiss-fortress types 'works only if the fortress is empty'). (d) Sphere of Annihilation attempt-control lacks 'If you are within 60 feet of an uncontrolled sphere'. (e) GREEN (executable) ops miss their printed actor: Rope of Entanglement escape-rope ('A target restrained by the rope can use an action') and Ioun Stone grab-orbiting-stone ('another creature must use an action to grasp or net the stone'); siblings Bead of Force 'An enclosed creature' and Apparatus 'A creature in the compartment' were typed. Adding a requirement does not change readiness (consumers ignore activation). (f) Unbounded targets: Chime of Opening strike-chime ('an object within 120 feet of you that can be opened'); Dimensional Shackles attach-shackles ('an incapacitated creature', Small to Large); Iron Flask containment.entry.trigger paraphrase 'target within 60 feet is native to another plane...' drops 'a creature that you can see' (magicItemContainmentInteractions.ts:232). Closure: each member typed with the verbatim printed span or its activation sentence carried as an adjudicated clause; re-run the operation-level sweep for OMITTED predicates (the screen checks only invention). Evidence: generalized - extend the existing per-root-cause scenario tests (holding on a staff, variant gate on a REC cast, actor on a green op) plus a recorded sibling sweep; no per-item reproducers.
S2 - State graphs: two members claimed EXACT are not closed, and unreviewed graphs keep differently-conditioned transitions and wrong lifecycle text. Invariant/authority: faithful-or-absent memory; 19.4.5.7 S4 ('Keep exceptions in the applicable branch, not in disconnected descriptive notes'); schema allows exactly one of via/timer/condition per transition (magicItemMechanics.ts:908), so a guard the vocabulary cannot state must be withheld (as done for Cloak of Displacement), not parked in a note. Members: (a) Apparatus of the Crab (S4.01, claimed EXACT; magicItemFaithfulLifecycles.ts:215-241): lever-10 direction lives only in transition notes; the only set-lever-10 transition from open goes to sealed and from sealed to open, so pushing lever 10 UP while open seals the hatch and DOWN while sealed opens it - the original S4.01 scenario 'repeated UP toggles a hatch shut' still holds. (b) Eversmoking Bottle (S4.09, claimed 'growth gated on open+within'; Lifecycles.ts:471-476): cloud-60->cloud-growing is an unconditional 1-minute timer; 'remains open and within the cloud' is only its note - moving the open bottle out of the cloud still grows it per the typed timer. (c) Outcome-dependent via transitions typed unconditional: Sphere of Annihilation uncontrolled->controlled via attempt-control fires on a FAILED DC 25 check (contradicting the item's own m5-complex-sphere-failed-control effect; magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:807); Iron Bands sphere->restraining via throw-bands fires on a MISS (printed: missing makes the bands contract into a sphere; magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:490); Rope of Entanglement loose->restraining via entangle-creature fires when the target SUCCEEDS on its DC 15 save (SimpleStateMachines.ts:663). (d) Wrong or invented lifecycle text/transitions: Immovable Rod termination lists 'successful DC 30 Strength check moves it 10 feet' as ending the fixed state (printed: the check moves the FIXED rod; it stays fixed; SimpleStateMachines.ts:434); Marvelous Pigments painting->realized condition 'value is at most 25 gp' and termination 'invalid/high-value depictions remain representations' contradict the printed outcome (a higher-value painting still becomes a real object of worthless material; ComplexStateMachines.ts:575); Folding Boat boat->ship and ship->boat transitions are unprinted (the words unfold 'the box'; ComplexStateMachines.ts:490). Closure: withhold any transition whose printed trigger/guard the vocabulary cannot state (adjudicated clause, verbatim span), correct conditions/terminations to verbatim printed spans, and correct the 19.4.6.2 member table for S4.01/S4.09. Evidence: generalized - extend the GRAPH_ITEMS verbatim condition/note/termination screen from 9 to all 49 machines (its disclosed limit 3 is exactly where (d) sits) plus one counterfactual for an outcome-gated via transition.
S3 - spellStore contracts keep an invented 'free' activation cost for the very uses whose operation cost this PR removed as unprinted. Invariant/authority: faithful-or-absent memory ('never invent defaults e.g. activation cost'); bead 19.4.6 scope explicitly includes spellStore; 19.4.5.7 S3 ('Spells rule preserves normal casting time unless the item changes it'). Members: Ring of Spell Storing ring-spell storeOn.cost and castOut.cost = 'free'; Ioun Stone (Reserve) ioun-reserve storeOn.cost and castOut.cost = 'free'; each carries note 'Uses the spell's normal casting time', contradicting its own typed value. Producer magicItemSpellRollInterop.ts:83-92. The schema already has the exact value 'spell-normal-casting-time' (MagicItemSpellContractEvent.cost, magicItemMechanics.ts:352), used by Rod of Absorption castOut. The PR dropped cost from the bound operations m9-store-ring-spell, m9-cast-ring-spell, m9-store-ioun-reserve, m9-cast-ioun-reserve with NO_COST clauses, so the same use is now 'no typed cost' on the operation and 'free' on its contract. Scenario: a consumer of the contract treats casting a stored 1-action fireball out of the ring as a free action. Closure: type 'spell-normal-casting-time' (exact) or drop the cost; no 'free'. Evidence: generalized - extend the whole-corpus cost screen to spellStore storeOn/castOut/absorbOn (reaction must be printed; free only for 'no action required').

S4 - Economy quantity role: Necklace of Prayer Beads bead-spells is per-day uses:1 for the whole necklace (producer magicItemUseEconomies.ts:514-525), while the printed rule is per bead ('Once a magic bead's spell is cast, that bead can't be used again until the next dawn'; the necklace has 1d4+2 magic beads). The note 'independent once-per-dawn counter for each magic bead' contradicts the typed pool. Invariant/authority: faithful-or-absent memory; 19.4.5.7 S6 (quantity/gate identity: 'literal-number agreement cannot prove the relation'); bead 19.4.6 owns economies. Scenario: a necklace with three magic beads can cast only one bead spell per dawn under the typed economy. Closure: a per-bead gate stated exactly, or the typed per-day pool withheld to an adjudicated clause with that verbatim sentence (cast-bead-spell keeps no invented shared cap). Evidence: one scenario assertion in the S6 block.

NOT FINDINGS (one line each): 'consume' activation cost is outside the cost-word screen - no requirement (consumption delivery, not an action-economy invention; accepted by 19.4.5.7). Orb grant revertOn compelled-dragon-reaches-orb - no requirement (arrival satisfies the printed compulsion). Cloak of the Bat end-polymorph note omits concentration - no requirement (it delegates to spell:polymorph). Sun Blade 'While grasping the hilt' - no requirement (weapon-wielding rule supplies holding). Goat of traveling revertOn duration-ended without a duration - no requirement (inert; depletion handled by its economy). Duplicated 'Uses the conjure elemental spell lifecycle' note prefix - no requirement (cosmetic). Operation census 361 vs 367 in the brief - no requirement (test counts independently). Activation cost made optional + non-empty activation validator - correct. Registry row magic-item-effects correctly defers these blocks to 19.4.6; inventory regenerated and consistent.

VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED (4)
